name: factiq
description: FactIQ plugins for sourced economic, financial, company, market, news, and satellite-data analysis.

plugins.name: factiq
plugins.description: Answer economic and financial data questions with real data from FactIQ — official statistics, market data, earnings-call transcripts, executive media appearances, central-bank speeches and minutes, a curated business-news feed, and satellite-derived data (nighttime lights, shipping and port activity, reservoir levels, crop fires and wildfires with mappable footprints, NO2/SO2/CO activity, smoke and dust aerosol, monsoon rainfall) — return sourced answers, chart JSON, or report JSON.
